build_videoclip_model: build a VideoCLIP model with pretrained DistilBERT text encoder and S3D video encoder
create_text_encoder: create a TextEncoder using DistilBERT to encode tokenized text into 768-dimensional embeddings
create_video_encoder: create a VideoEncoder using S3D to encode video clips into 1024-dimensional embeddings
create_projection_layer: create a Projection layer to map embeddings to a fixed output dimension with residual connections
test_videoclip_forward: test the VideoCLIP model forward pass with tokenized text and video tensor inputs
